zh: 新增过程行的单列风格：设置页「主窗口」的「对话」中可在平铺与单列之间选择，单列把展开的过程组画成一张细边框卡片，每个过程占一行，单行显示它的描述，行尾带展开箭头；过程组整体不限高，展开的思考正文保留独立限高与滚动；默认仍是平铺。
en: Add a column style for process rows: the Conversation group of the Main window tab in settings chooses between flat and column, and the column style draws an open process group as one bordered card with each step on a line of its own, its description on a single line and a disclosure arrow at the end; the group has no height cap, while an opened thought keeps its own capped scrolling area; flat stays the default.
